name: Warmachine
body:
The Greatest of Orcs’ power guides your hand in the creation of implements of war.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a god of warfare

Benefit: You receive a +2 divine bonus to your CMB and to any Knowledge skill checks made while planning for battle or war.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
